questions.question: Which Major League Baseball team beat the Tampa Bay Rays to capture their first World Series title in franchise history?
questions.explanation: The Milwaukee Brewers won the World Series in five games against the Tampa Bay Rays, earning their maiden title.
questions.context: 2026 World Series: In baseball, the Milwaukee Brewers defeat the Tampa Bay Rays in five games to win their first World Series championship in franchise history.

questions.question: Which British political activist was convicted in court of harassing two journalists and putting them in fear of violence?
questions.explanation: Tommy Robinson was found guilty of harassment that caused two reporters to fear violent harm.
questions.context: British far-right activist Tommy Robinson is convicted of harassing two journalists and causing them to fear violence.

questions.question: Which political party, led by prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu, lost its plurality of parliamentary seats in recent national elections?
questions.explanation: Benjamin Netanyahu's coalition and his Likud party lost their plurality in the Knesset, leaving a hung parliament.
questions.context: 2026 Israeli legislative election: Incumbent prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu and his Likud party-led governing coalition loses a plurality of seats in the Knesset, though no alliance wins a majority, leaving government formation unclear.

questions.question: Which company set a new record for the largest initial public offering in Indian history after generating 3.2 billion US dollars?
questions.explanation: Jio Platforms set a national record by raising 3.2 billion dollars in its Mumbai stock market debut.
questions.context: Jio Platforms raises US$3.2 billion in India's largest-ever initial public offering (IPO), attracting about $77 billion in bids and becoming the country's most-subscribed IPO before its stock-market debut in Mumbai.

questions.story: Rwanda–United States relations, Democratic Republic of the Congo–Rwanda conflict
questions.question: The United States introduced sanctions against the defence ministry of which country over allegations of supporting M23 rebel fighters?
questions.explanation: The US targeted the Rwandan defence ministry with sanctions over accusations of backing rebels in the neighbouring DR Congo.
questions.context: Rwanda–United States relations, Democratic Republic of the Congo–Rwanda conflict: The United States imposes sanctions on the Rwandan ministry of defence over its role in the conflict in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, alleging that Rwanda is backing the M23 rebels to fight against Congolese forces.
